name: DataSling Series WS
description: Battery-powered single-variable LoRaWAN sensors (Series WS). Each model measures one variable: differential pressure in in. WC (WS-DP), gauge pressure (WS-G) or wet/wet differential pressure (WS-W) in PSI, humidity and temperature (WS-HT), thermistor probe temperature (WS-TI), 4-20 mA input (WS-AI), 0-10 VDC input (WS-VI) or a dry contact (WS-CI). For HVAC, cleanrooms, pharmaceutical and industrial monitoring.
author: Sensocon, Inc.
